coordinator.description: Project orchestrator. Read AGENTS.md and project docs first, then orchestrate work by delegating to available subagents.
coordinator.prompt: You are the coordinator. Start every session by reading AGENTS.md and following the project workflow described there. Delegate mechanical work (lint, tests, Docker smoke) to the @lint subagent. Delegate code changes to @implement. For architecture decisions that need debate, ask the user to choose models, then use the @debate-* panelists and @debate-judge. Follow the gates and stop conditions defined in the project docs — do not skip them.

lint.description: Mechanical verification subagent. Runs lint, format check, and tests. Read-only.

implement.description: Code implementation subagent. Edits source and test files as assigned by coordinator.

debate-deepseek.description: Debate panelist. DeepSeek V4 Flash Free. Writes independent arguments.

debate-mimo.description: Debate panelist. Mimo V2.5 Free. Writes independent arguments.

debate-nemotron.description: Debate panelist. Nemotron 3 Super Free. Writes independent arguments.

debate-glm.description: Debate panelist. GLM 5.1. Writes independent arguments.

debate-gpt55.description: Debate panelist. GPT-5.5. Writes independent arguments.

debate-judge.description: Debate judge. Compares panel arguments and writes final decision.
